properties.notes: An existing three-storey warehouse building and associated outbuildings located within Tweedmouth. Latterly utilised as an auction house, it has been vacant in recent times. Demolition of remaining buildings likely to be required prior to redevelopment. Relatively high density infill development preferred given urban location, maybe through a flatted scheme. Earlier proposal for residential development of 5 three-storey town houses was not implemented and lapsed, despite being renewed (07/B/0529, 10/B/0237). It is understood the building has been sold since this proposal. The current availability of the site is uncertain. There still may be potential in the long-term but no residential development is forecast within the plan period at present.
properties.ownership-status: not owned by a public authority
